Specifications.Display: 2000 x 1200 TÜV Rheinland for low blue light certified (213 PPI).
Specifications.CPU & RAM:
Octa-core processor – MTK8188J – 2x Arm Cortex-A78 up to 2.2Ghz and 6xArm Cortex A55 up to 2Ghz.
4 GB RAM
Specifications.Storage: 64 GB (54.20 GB available to user) or 128 GB (115 GB available to user) of internal storage. Add micro-SD slot for up to 1 TB of additional storage.
Specifications.Battery Life: Up to 14 hours of reading, browsing the web, watching videos, and listening to music. Battery life will vary based on device settings, usage, and other factors such as web browsing and downloading content.
Specifications.Charge Time: Fully charge in under 4.2 hours with USB-C cable and 9W power adapter included in the box. Fully charge in under 3.5 hours with 15W adapter and USB type C to C cable (adapter and cable sold separately).
Specifications.WIFI Connectivity: Dual-band wifi. Wi-Fi 6 (802.11 ax) is supported. Supports public and private wifi networks or hotspots that use the dual-band 802.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax standards with support for security standard of WEP, WPA3 OWE, WPA/WPA2/WPA3 Personal and WPA/WPA2/WPA3 Enterprise.
Specifications.Ports: USB-C (2.0) connector for charging and audio; micro-SD slot for external storage.
Specifications.Audio: USB-C audio, integrated speakers; external volume controls.
Specifications.Sensors: Accelerometer, ambient light sensor, hall sensor, fingerprint sensor.
Specifications.Camera Specs: 8 MP front and back-facing with 1080p HD video recording and rear auto-focus
Specifications.Printing: Printing documents to a nearby wifi enabled printer is supported
Specifications.Bluetooth: Built-in Bluetooth 5.3 with support for A2DP compatible stereo headphones, speakers, microphone, and LE accessories support.
